source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Algeria 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Algerian crest and adidas logo on the chest, 'Algeria' in Arabic on the back of the collar and no commercial sponsor on any placement, with matching sponsor-free shorts and socks.
source.quote: The Algerian crest appears in the centre of the chest beneath the adidas logo, while the back of the collar displays “Algeria” written in Arabic script.

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the FAF crest, adidas branding and 'Algeria' in Arabic on the back of the collar, with matching shorts and socks.
